name: Humber Bridge toll
law: Humber Bridge Board's tolls (Humber Bridge Acts 1959 and 2013) per crossing, either way, as published: two-axle vehicles of 3.5-7 t GBP 5.00, three axles or more over 7.5 t GBP 15.00; with `etc` the account price (4.00, 12.00). Two-axle trucks over 7 t are taken at the two-axle price. The page gives no date: valid_from is the day it was first read.
